name: 冬冠石王
prompt: Production small raster animation sprites for a polished hand-painted fantasy RPG, crisp miniature art, NOT chibi, NOT 3D. OPAQUE PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background, RGB, no alpha or transparency. EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, 24 full-body poses total. Each equal cell contains ONE entire creature with 15% magenta margin all sides. No overlap between cells, no grid lines, no text, no scenery, no floor shadows. Same creature identity, scale and camera every pose, enemy facing LEFT three-quarter side view. Row1 six poses of breathing/hovering IDLE LOOP. Row2 six distinct ATTACK keyframes: ready, anticipation, coil, strong contact attack, follow-through, recover. Row3 six HIT recoil/recovery frames. Row4 six DEFEAT frames from standing through collapse into motionless fallen final pose; no gore. Source format landscape, 1536x1024 preferred. Creature should be around 140px tall per cell, leave room for weapons and tail. Strong action silhouettes, no identical poses substituting attacks. SUBJECT: gigantic northern stone king, ancient granite body with glacial blue ice armor, jagged ice crown and engraved knotwork shoulders, enormous fists. Motion: heavy idle then lifts both arms and hammers ground forward. Northern winter culture. Keep ALL effects and extremities inside each cell with broad magenta gutters.
